description: Adds "cartoon" to template_category: an 8th deterministic template, alongside the 7 motion-graphics ones, rendering SVG puppet characters in reusable backgrounds instead of stock imagery. Template scenes require only scene_index, template_category and template_data; non-template scenes retain the legacy media-search fields. MINOR bump per RFC 0007: existing 1.0.0-1.2.0 artifacts remain valid.

search_terms.description: Concrete media-search subjects. Required only for non-template scenes; deterministic template scenes do not fetch stock media.

visual_style.description: Legacy media-generation/search style hint. Required only for non-template scenes.

fallback_terms.description: Fallback media-search subjects. Required only for non-template scenes.

template_category.description: If set, this scene uses a deterministic template instead of stock/AI scene media. The first 7 are documented in engine/prompts/visual_planner; "cartoon" is documented in engine/prompts/cartoon_visual_planner.

template_data.description: JSON-encoded props for the selected template. For cartoon: {"background":{"location":"bedroom","variant":"night","tone":"scary"},"camera":{"type":"pan","panFrom":0,"panTo":-80},"characters":[{"characterId":"pilot","x":260,"y":380,"isSpeaking":true,"expression":"surprised"}]}.
